text: The 2023 loss was caused by tree-cover loss, confirmed by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (4.5 ha). The area was mapped as forest in 2020 (JRC GFC2020), and the loss primarily occurred in planted pine forest (4.3 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*, per MGAP 2021). However, there is no direct evidence linking this loss to storm damage. The loss was not part of a larger storm-related event, as the area affected (4.5 ha) was relatively small and did not align with typical storm damage patterns. Additional ground-based or meteorological data would be needed to confirm storm damage as the cause.
